meta.name: Monster of the Week
meta.notes: Seat limits are decision D3 (3.16). Rules: the first draft (Appendix G). Cards: Set v2 (H.8) plus scaffold placeholders for the six extras (H.6). Numbers: first-draft guesses (G.7), each a variant. Map: the prototype board, layout D (testing only).

slayerGroups.name: AV Club
slayerGroups.trope: Teen hackers and computer club nerds

slayerGroups.name: Father and the Flock
slayerGroups.trope: A parish exorcist and reluctant helpers

cards.name: Leave Out Fresh Meat
cards.text: The largest group adjacent to the target moves into it, all of it. Target: the bait location.

cards.name: Track Them in the Snow
cards.text: Drive the target group hex by bordering hex, leaving 1 token and 1 of your influence in each location entered, while your influence with that faction lasts. A location it can't enter ends the chase; leftover tokens stay together at the last location. Target: the group chased.

cards.name: Silver Bullets
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, each group loses 2 more tokens as casualties, and the token’s owner takes those as a pile of their own. (Revised in round 17.)

response.name: Never Invite Them In
response.text: When a player is about to move tokens into a location where you have influence, block it; the tokens stay where they are.

cards.name: Broadcast a Signal
cards.text: Call the groups of one faction from up to two locations anywhere into the target. Target: where they answer.

readings.location: any faction, into an ↂ location.
readings.faction: the Sci-Fi faction, into any location.

cards.name: Leak the Documents
cards.text: Half the target group, rounded down, leaves for an adjacent location of your choice. Target: the group split.

readings.location: any group at an ↂ location.

cards.name: Beam Them Up
cards.text: Lift the target group and set it down at any location on the island. Target: the group taken.

readings.location: any group at an ↂ location.

response.name: Classified
response.text: When a hidden token is placed, look at its face.

cards.name: Spread a Virus
cards.text: The target group puts 1 token into every adjacent location it can enter, as far as its tokens go. Target: the infected group.

cards.name: Reroute the Power Grid
cards.text: Move one faction's tokens from every location in the target's region into the target. Target: the destination.

cards.name: Reprogram the Traffic Lights
cards.text: Choose one of the six hex directions; every group of the target moves one hex that way, where it can.

readings.location: every group in a ⏏ location's region.
readings.faction: every Sentient group on the island.

response.name: Pull the Plug
response.text: When a player spends a card for influence, they gain 1 less, and you gain 1 with the same faction.

cards.name: Ring the Church Bell
cards.text: Every token in adjacent locations is drawn into the target. Target: where the bell rings.

cards.name: Board Up the Windows
cards.text: The target group is turned away, split across at least two adjacent locations. Target: the group.

cards.name: Salt and Burn the Bones
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, both groups lose all their tokens; trophies are handed out as normal and the location is not scorched.

response.name: Hold a Séance
response.text: When any player passes, look at the cards left out this round.

cards.name: Draw a Summoning Circle
cards.text: Every group of one faction in neighbouring regions moves into the target. Target: the circle.

cards.name: Light Every Lamp
cards.text: At a contested location, the target faction is driven to an adjacent location of your choice, so the fight there doesn't happen. Target: the faction driven out.

readings.location: the smaller faction at a contested ⎈ location.
readings.faction: the Demons, wherever they are contested.

cards.name: Set the House on Fire
cards.text: Hidden: any fight here counts as a true tie: both groups are wiped out and the location is scorched.

response.name: Sign in Blood
response.text: When a player spends influence from a faction, gain 1 influence with the Demon faction.

cards.name: Set a Trap
cards.text: Name a location; the first group to move into it this round loses half (rounded down), as your trophies. Target: the location.

cards.name: Lock Down the Town
cards.text: Name a region; this round, no group moves into or out of it. Target: a location in the region.

cards.name: Put a Bounty On It
cards.text: Name a faction; at every fight this round, its group loses 1 more token when it wins, into the trophy piles. Target: the faction.

cards.name: Plan B
cards.text: Pivot: move up to 3 of your influence from other locations to one location.

variants.label: Presence threshold
variants.description: The invaders win if total presence is more than this (TH1). First-draft guess 20 (G.7).

variants.label: Growth threshold
variants.description: A lone faction with at least this many tokens at a location grows (GR1).

variants.label: Tokens per faction
variants.description: Each faction's tokens, board and supply together (G.7).

variants.label: Cubes per player
variants.description: Each player's influence cubes (G.7). 30 while the cards are designed: a bump from 20 so the supply rarely limits play (designer, 2026-10-07); the balancing number comes later.

variants.label: Starting influence
variants.description: Influence each slayer group starts with, with its linked faction (G.7). Designer (2026-10-07): start with more influence on the affinity faction; 5 is Claude’s suggested starting number (was 3), to measure.

variants.label: Starting standing with other factions
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07): each player starts with 1 influence with every faction other than their affinity faction. 0 was the first draft before.

variants.label: Starting influence on affinity locations
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07): each slayer group starts with 1 influence on the board at each of its affinity locations (its archetype’s three), from its supply.

variants.label: Slayer groups
variants.description: How slayer groups are given out (G.7).

choices.label: Random
choices.description: Each seat draws a slayer group at random.

choices.label: Seat order
choices.description: Seats take slayer groups in spec order.

variants.label: Influence per move
variants.description: Test lever (influence economy, 2026-10-07): influence a move places at each destination, from standing with the faction moved (CA2).

variants.label: Influence onto the board
variants.description: Test lever (influence economy, 2026-10-07): when a card is spent for influence, 1 of it goes onto a location its faction controls.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: The first draft: all to standing.

choices.label: On
choices.description: Test lever: 1 onto a controlled location, the player's choice.

variants.label: Influence as a requirement
variants.description: IC1 (designer, 2026-10-07, first draft): the card says how much influence a move places, and that is a requirement, paid from standing with the faction moved. A move goes only as far as the player can pay: with 1 standing, a card that places 1 per location spread to spreads to one location. Cards that place no influence have no requirement.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: Before IC1: any move is allowed; influence is placed only as far as standing goes.

variants.label: Who pays to move several factions
variants.description: D15 (designer, 2026-10-07; first-draft starting place, not set in stone): each faction moved to a new location costs 1 influence from that faction, placed on the new location, regardless of the size of the group moved. A draw-in can place up to two; a spread more. Alternative: only the selected faction pays.

choices.label: Each faction
choices.description: The first draft: each faction moved to a new location pays 1 influence from that faction, placed there; a group you can’t pay for stays.

choices.label: Selected faction
choices.description: Alternative: only the faction you select (or lead) pays; the other factions come along free and place nothing. It moves first.

variants.label: Extra influence from cards
variants.description: Test lever (designer, 2026-10-07: bump the influence cards provide): added to every suited card’s printed influence when it is spent for influence. 0 is the first draft.

variants.label: Influence where tokens leave
variants.description: Test lever (influence economy, 2026-10-07): a move also places 1 influence where the tokens left from.

variants.label: Responses
variants.description: Out of the first draft (designer, 2026-10-07): responses stay candidate ideas. Off: a played action resolves at once and cards' responses are ignored.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: The first draft: no responses; actions resolve at once.

choices.label: On
choices.description: Responses and the pending step (the earlier prototype).

variants.label: Deck
variants.description: Prototype test plumbing, not a rule. Mixed: when the game is created, each suit draws one Strike, one Shift and one Signature at random from the deck and the test cards, printed 2, 3 and 4 influence in random order (9 per suit, D12); the unsuited extras stay. Fixed: the 21-card Set v2.

choices.label: Mixed
choices.description: A random card per slot per suit, from the deck and the test cards.

map.notes: Prototype board, layout D (the first draft's map; not a decision). Axial hex coordinates; directions E, NE, NW, W, SW, SE. Adjacent means hexes sharing a border. Mirror is the reflection across the lake.

testCards.notes: Cards out of the fixed deck: rounds 8 to 19 ideas (rounds 14 to 19: unsuited extras, rounds 18 and 19 marked-card candidates (Set a Trap, Lock Down the Town and Put a Bounty On It adopted as A, C and D); rounds 17 to 19: revisions of the weakest) under measurement by scripts/tournament.js. A mixed deck (variant deck) can deal them. Their slots are provisional, assigned by Claude from 3.7’s slot definitions (Strike makes a contest, Shift concentrates or scatters, Signature bends a rule); influence is set per game. Not rules.

cards.name: Raise the Force Field
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, the winner loses no tokens.

readings.faction: a location holding the Sci-Fi faction.

cards.name: Hijack the Feed
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, the token's owner counts their influence there twice when the trophies are handed out.

cards.name: Sign the Contract
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, the token’s owner takes the bigger pile and the leader only the smaller; the owner pays 2 standing with the Demons for the deal. (Revised in round 17.)

cards.name: Leak It to the Press
cards.text: Half the target group, rounded down, goes to any location on the island it can enter. Target: the group split.

readings.location: any group at an ↂ location.

cards.name: Light Every Lamp (either side)
cards.text: At a contested location, either faction is driven to an adjacent location of your choice, so the fight there doesn’t happen. Target: the faction driven out.

readings.location: either faction at a contested ⎈ location.
readings.faction: the Demons, wherever they are contested.

cards.name: Spread a Virus (infectious)
cards.text: The target group puts 1 token into every adjacent location it can enter, as far as its tokens go. Where a token joins another faction, that faction loses 1 token to its supply. Target: the infected group.

cards.name: Wait for the Full Moon
cards.text: Up to 3 tokens from the faction’s supply join the target group. Target: the group.

cards.name: Turn On the Tractor Beam
cards.text: Both groups at the target are lifted together into an adjacent location with no tokens; the fight happens there. Target: the contest.

readings.location: a contest at an ↂ location.
readings.faction: a contest the Sci-Fi faction is in.

cards.name: Reprogram the Drones
cards.text: Up to 3 tokens of the target group change sides: they join the other faction at that location (swapped through the supplies). Target: the group that defects.

readings.location: a group in a contest at a ⏏ location.
readings.faction: a group fighting the Sentients; its tokens become Sentients.

cards.name: Hear the Banshee Wail
cards.text: Every group next to the target is driven one hex straight on, away from it, where it can enter. Target: where she wails.

readings.location: a ☾ location; any faction is driven.
readings.faction: anywhere; only Undead groups are driven.

cards.name: Open the Pit
cards.text: The target group, 3 tokens or fewer, falls through to any location in its region it can enter. Target: the group, then where it lands. (Revised in round 17.)

readings.location: a small group at a ⎈ location.
readings.faction: a small group sharing a location with the Demons.

cards.name: Chase Them Down the Slope
cards.text: Choose a direction; the target group slides hex by hex that way until it reaches a location it can’t enter, or the coast. Target: the group.

cards.name: Crash-Land the Saucer
cards.text: Choose a direction; the target group moves one hex that way. Any group of another faction in its way is knocked one hex on, the same way, and so on down the line; a group with nowhere to go stays. Target: the group.

readings.location: any group at an ↂ location.

cards.name: Livestream the Fight
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, each trophy pile is doubled from its faction’s supply.

cards.name: Lay Them to Rest
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, the token’s owner takes the smaller pile; the rest go back to their supplies. (Revised in round 17.)

cards.name: Trade Souls
cards.text: The target group trades places with any other group on the island, if each can stand where the other was. Target: the first soul.

cards.name: Circle the Prey
cards.text: The groups round the target circle it: each moves one location on, clockwise, where it can enter. Target: the prey.

cards.name: Follow the Lights
cards.text: The target group moves to an adjacent location; then a group of another faction next to that location may follow it in. Target: the leader.

readings.location: any group at an ↂ location.

cards.name: Install the Cameras
cards.text: Place 1 influence from your supply at the target and at each location next to it that holds tokens. Target: the hub. (Revised in round 17.)

cards.name: Drag Them Under
cards.text: The target group and a neighbouring group of another faction are both dragged into a location next to them both. Target: the first group.

cards.name: Invert the Pentagram
cards.text: Hidden: at its fight, the smaller group wins.

cards.name: Howl at the Moon
cards.text: Every group of one faction two hexes from the target moves one hex closer (to a location next to it; one already holding that faction if it can). Target: where the howl rises.

readings.location: a ◐ location; any one faction answers.

cards.name: Back Up to the Cloud
cards.text: Move the target group across the network, however far. Target: the group moved. (Round 7 wording, first built in round 13.)

readings.location: any group, from one ⏏ location to another.
readings.faction: a Sentient group, to any location holding another Sentient group.

cards.name: Lead the Horde
cards.text: Move the target group into an adjacent location; if that would make three factions there, the smaller group already there is shoved on to an adjacent location of your choice. Target: the horde. (Round 7 wording, first built in round 13.)

cards.name: Read from the Book
cards.text: The target group leaps over an adjacent location into the one beyond it, in a straight line. Target: the group. (Round 6 idea, first built in round 13; readings added.)

cards.name: Smash the Mirror
cards.text: Move the target group to its reflection across the lake. Target: the group. (Round 6 idea, first built in round 13; readings added.)

readings.location: a group at a ⎈ location or its reflection.
readings.faction: a Demon group with a reflection.

cards.name: Bail Out
cards.text: Pivot: move all your influence at one location to any other location. Target: where you bail out from, then where it goes.

cards.name: Call for Backup
cards.text: Double your influence at the target; the extra comes from your supply. Target: a location where you have influence.

cards.name: Fall Back
cards.text: Pivot: move all your influence from every location next to the target into it. Target: the rallying point.

cards.name: Stake Out
cards.text: Place 4 influence from your supply on the target. Target: any location. (Designer seed, 2026-10-07.)

cards.name: Claim the Spoils
cards.text: At this round’s fight at the target, you take every pile, whoever leads. You can’t play it as your last card in hand. Target: any location.

cards.name: Call a Truce
cards.text: There is no fight at the target this round; both groups stay. Target: any location.

cards.name: Steal Their Playbook
cards.text: Play the action of the last card played this game, as if it were yours. Its own target rules apply.

cards.name: Lay a Trail
cards.text: Move a whole group into a location where you alone have the most influence, from a location next to it. Target: your location, then the group.

cards.name: Canvass the Town
cards.text: Place 1 influence from your supply at each of up to four locations. Target: the locations.

cards.name: Set the Bait
cards.text: Place 2 influence from your supply at the target, then draw a whole group into it from a location next to it. Target: the bait, then the group.

cards.name: Defect
cards.text: Move up to 4 of your standing from one faction to another. Target: the faction you leave, then the one you join.

cards.name: Raise the Stakes
cards.text: At a contested location, place influence from your supply equal to the larger group there (up to 5). Target: the contest. (Round 17.)

cards.name: Trade Secrets
cards.text: Swap your standing with two factions. Target: the two factions. (Round 17.)

cards.name: Split Up, Gang!
cards.text: Opening gambit (marked-card candidate for B): place 1 influence from your supply at up to three locations in different regions; this round, your influence at each counts double at its fight. Target: the locations.

cards.name: Tip Off the Sheriff
cards.text: Opening gambit (marked-card candidate for B): name a faction; for the rest of the round, whenever anyone moves it, place 1 influence from your supply where it lands. Target: the faction.

cards.name: Wake the Dead
cards.text: This round, the fight at the target can’t scorch it, and the losing faction’s casualties rise there as Undead instead of becoming trophies. Target: the graveyard.

cards.name: Network the Virus
cards.text: The target group sends 1 token to every other location holding its faction, anywhere on the island, as far as its tokens go. Target: the infected group.
